scope_note: 연구설계 검토이며 실행, native construction, manuscript writing, publication 또는 SOTA 승인 아님. 선행 성능은 모두 저자 보고이며 로컬 재현이 아니다.

findings.source: paper/research/five-reviewer-design-review-20260907/packet/review-brief.md §Governing user direction/§Candidate native ownership L3–5,L28–34; paper/research/five-reviewer-design-review-20260907/packet/integrated-research-design-active.md §3–4 L21–38; paper/research/five-reviewer-design-review-20260907/packet/study-contract.json treatment L47–56
findings.problem: 최신 지시는 graph-based integrated architecture를 실험으로 선택하라고 하지만 초안은 research-continuity package를 이미 선택하고 typed graph를 optional로 둔다.
findings.impact: negative-result reuse의 효과만으로 graph control plane의 필요성, representation 대 control, prototype ownership을 선택할 수 없다.
findings.revision: Primary를 GRAPH/EVIDENCE CONTROL PACKAGE 대 strong source-backed iterative tree/notebook으로 바꾸고 conditional negative-result reuse와 interruption을 사전 지정 진단으로 둔다.
findings.closure_evidence: 두 arm의 state/action/information/owner 차이, 논문 RQ와 prototype decision mapping, 등록되지 않은 차이 제거를 담은 preregistered manifest의 immutable hash.

findings.problem: Strong baseline은 기능 목록일 뿐 runnable identity가 아니다. HoH core는 저장 snapshot에 없고, Prime/Scroll/Meta^n의 paper experiment code 동등성은 미확인이고, SkillZip/RecEvolve/Terminal-Universe canonical code도 식별되지 않았다.
findings.impact: 약한 prompt를 strong이라고 부르거나 incomplete inspired implementation을 full-system reproduction으로 오인할 수 있다.
findings.revision: 현재 고정 Prime substrate 위에 exact code/config/prompt hash, state schema, raw-source access, restart/handoff, validity checklist, critique와 experiment slots가 있는 baseline을 고정한다. 외부 체계는 inspired/mechanism-matched로만 표기한다.
findings.closure_evidence: 두 runnable manifests, byte hashes, code-path activation receipts, equal prompt/config adaptation ledger, blinded pre-run comparison audit. Full reproduction 표기는 official commit/dependencies/adapter/model/scorer/reference가 모두 확인될 때만 허용.

findings.source: paper/research/five-reviewer-design-review-20260907/packet/integrated-research-design-active.md §6 L53–65,§12 L123; paper/research/five-reviewer-design-review-20260907/packet/study-contract.json first_task_search L70–86,analysis L88–100; paper/research/five-reviewer-design-review-20260907/packet/review-brief.md §Feasible study choices L36–43; paper/research/long-horizon-harness-benchmark-20260907/hoh-method-audit.md §1 L16–22
findings.problem: 공개 ML research campaign, gold, metric, confirmatory N과 power가 없다. 저장 논문의 coding/retrieval/skill/SFT task를 실제 autonomous ML research campaign으로 대체할 수도 없다.
findings.impact: 긴 trace, seed, round, candidate 또는 checkpoint를 독립 연구 성공으로 과대계수할 위험이 있다.
findings.revision: 독립 public task/source families로 coherent small-compute ML bundle을 인증한다. 각 campaign은 공통 starting baseline, 경쟁 가설, 실제 train/evaluate, result-conditioned next decision, interruption, frozen final artifact를 포함한다. Family/campaign만 inference unit으로 둔다.
findings.closure_evidence: License/data/source ancestry, fixed train/dev/hidden-test split, failure rule, task metric/common estimand, family-independence audit, development-confirmation separation, power/precision calculation을 가진 frozen task certificate.

findings.source: paper/research/five-reviewer-design-review-20260907/packet/study-contract.json matched_controls/analysis/execution L24–34,L88–100,L118–131; paper/research/long-horizon-harness-benchmark-20260907/sources/2609.01481v1-layout.txt Table 2 LF727–733 and Appendix B.2 LF1471–1475; paper/research/long-horizon-harness-benchmark-20260907/hoh-method-audit.md §5.1 L108–126; paper/research/long-horizon-harness-benchmark-20260907/recevolve-claim-audit.md §3 L77–86
findings.problem: Equal ceiling 원칙은 있으나 수치 budget, sampling/provider nondeterminism, pricing, full cost와 failed-attempt population flow가 고정되지 않았다.
findings.impact: Graph arm의 preprocessing/retrieval/critique/retry 우위 또는 baseline budget exhaustion을 mechanism effect로 오인할 수 있다.
findings.revision: Model/revision/thinking/temperature/top-p/seed, context/cache/tool/source rights, experiment/critic/recovery slots와 small budget grid를 고정한다. Input/output/cache-aware tokens, discovery/source reads, graph cost, root+child work, ORX compute, assessor, retries/failures, human intervention, worker/wall time을 전부 센다.
findings.closure_evidence: 값이 채워진 cost schema, runtime/pricing snapshot, every admitted attempt ledger, intention-to-run failure policy, pre-outcome checksum이 있는 quality-cost analysis code.

findings.source: paper/research/long-horizon-harness-benchmark-20260907/sources/2609.01437v1-layout.txt §4.3 LF789–794; paper/research/long-horizon-harness-benchmark-20260907/sources/2608.24735v1-layout.txt §2.4 LF365–372; paper/research/long-horizon-harness-benchmark-20260907/meta-environment-audit.md §1.3 L43–58,§2.4 L111–124; paper/research/long-horizon-harness-benchmark-20260907/sources/2609.04148v1-layout.txt §3.3 LF407–412; paper/research/long-horizon-harness-benchmark-20260907/sources/2608.21690v1-layout.txt Table 2 LF433–438; paper/research/long-horizon-harness-benchmark-20260907/source-receipts.json L462–470
findings.problem: Archive-best, best seed/checkpoint, success-filtered records, external reference numbers, teacher/training changes와 현재성 미확인 landscape가 SOTA 문구로 유입될 수 있다.
findings.impact: Portfolio oracle, selection optimism 또는 student SFT gain을 one frozen research harness의 성과로 오인하게 된다.
findings.revision: Dev-only로 final artifact 또는 router를 먼저 고정하고 hidden family score를 primary로 한 번 연다. 모든 candidate/failure를 보존한다. Training/task generation/model-weight 변화는 별도 study로 분리하며 직접 comparator가 없으면 SOTA를 포기한다.
findings.closure_evidence: Timestamped final-selection receipt, hidden access log, all-candidate ledger, no-heldout-reselection rule, independent scorer calibration, current literature search/screening receipt, official pinned direct comparator의 matched run.

findings.problem: Graph edge와 applicability field가 independent gold에서 주입되면 end-to-end graph research가 아니라 oracle-assisted control만 시험하게 된다.
findings.impact: 같은 raw evidence라는 표면 조건 아래 treatment에만 정답 구조를 제공하는 leakage가 생긴다.
findings.revision: Primary에서는 graph extraction을 treatment 비용과 오류에 포함하거나, control-only ablation에서는 양 arm에 동일 extracted records를 준다. 두 estimand를 혼합하지 않는다.
findings.closure_evidence: Treatment-blind semantic edge audit, known-wrong/missing-edge negative controls, extraction error ledger, end-to-end와 control-only 결과의 별도 명명.

reusable_evidence: 여덟 원문의 hashed source receipts와 46 exact locators
Evolving object가 다른 체계를 한 leaderboard로 합치지 않는 benchmark matrix
HoH의 frozen-candidate/QA와 post-run scorer 분리 및 pass-controlled unequal-token 경계
HarnessDev의 feedback 대 held-out declared-final selection 경계
Scroll의 addressability 대 evidence exposure/sufficiency 구분
SkillZip의 structural guarantee 대 semantic validity 구분
RecEvolve의 조건부 negative-result reuse 동기와 human-detected proxy hack
Meta^n의 archive-best 대 one frozen chain/router 구분
Terminal-Universe의 observed/inferred lineage와 training selection 대 research denominator 구분
Prime의 root+descendant resource accounting 원칙과 local exact-byte/provenance instruments
quarantined_evidence: B3: small allocation development evidence only
C64: INVALID for causal claims; nominal p=.03125 does not rescue it
Retrospective graph/replay and offline witnesses: mechanism/instrument fixtures only
UI-parity v12: 30/30 pre-observation crashes, INVALID/NOT_ADMITTED, no retry

World initialization: static protocol/lifecycle only, no admitted full run
All eight-paper performance: author-reported, not locally reproduced
External reference scores, archive maxima, selected successes, trimmed training suffixes and SFT student gains as local harness efficacy or power priors
strongest_alternate_explanation: Graph가 reasoning/control 때문에 이긴 것이 아니라 더 많은 correctness metadata, context, preprocessing, critic calls 또는 candidate-selection 기회를 받았다는 설명. 동일 information rights/opportunities, full-cost accounting, treatment-blind oracle audit와 representation-versus-control ablation이 이를 닫아야 한다.

decisive_experiment.name: Held-out public small-compute ML research campaigns: graph/evidence control package versus strong source-backed iterative tree/notebook
decisive_experiment.stage_0: Development-only task/protocol qualification. Environment, split, scorer, failure semantics, campaign horizon and variance를 확인하고 effect threshold, N, budget를 outcome 전에 고정한다.

stage_1_arms.B: Current fixed Prime/Pi substrate의 persistent hypothesis/result/failure tree or notebook. Raw sources, versions/applicability facts, exact expansion, restart/handoff, validity checklist, critique와 same experiment slots 포함.
stage_1_arms.G: B와 동일 facts/rights에 typed source→claim→hypothesis→experiment→result→decision/successor graph 및 mandatory eligibility/reopen/preservation traversal만 추가. Graph DB/framework 자체는 treatment 아님.

matched_controls: frozen discovery corpus and Exa candidate/source opportunity ceiling
ORX run authority and experiment slots
decisive_experiment.horizon: 각 campaign은 baseline, 둘 이상의 competing hypotheses, 실제 train/evaluate, result-conditioned next decision와 사전 지정 interruption 1회를 포함한다.
decisive_experiment.primary_endpoint: Hidden scoring 전에 dev evidence로 선택한 단일 frozen artifact의 independent task-specific terminal metric at fixed total budget.
decisive_experiment.analysis: Paired by independent task/source family. Seeds, rounds, candidates and checkpoints are nested. Clustered uncertainty and predeclared practical-effect gate 사용.
decisive_experiment.conditional_stage_2: Stage 1이 material effect 및 uncertainty/cost gate를 넘을 때만 graph representation without compulsory control 대 full graph control을 비교한다. Compression, Meta^n depth, training, model change, task synthesis는 병목 근거가 있을 때 각각 별도 연구로 둔다.
decisive_experiment.falsifier: G advantage가 checklist-equipped B, equal information/opportunities 또는 full cost에서 사라지거나, false invalidation/suppression margin을 넘거나, hidden terminal outcome을 개선하지 못하면 integrated graph-control benefit을 주장하지 않는다.

sota_claim_conditions: Cutoff/query/screening/exclusion이 남은 최신 primary-source landscape와 selection-week verification
같은 research object/public benchmark의 official pinned runnable comparator 또는 SOTA 포기
Official code/commit, dependencies, model settings, scorer and reference behavior가 확인된 경우만 full-system reproduction 표기
Preselected frozen final의 unseen task-family outcome와 적절한 uncertainty
External references, archive maxima, success filtering, teacher/task/scorer changes and student SFT gains의 직접 비교 배제

MLAgentBench/MLE-bench-related autonomous ML research systems — candidates only, not verified in this review
completion_criteria_before_writing: 최신 직접 비교문헌의 full-paper/source-code status audit 완료
Frozen task/protocol/budget/sampling/failure/selection contract와 explicit user execution authority
Baseline과 G의 identity, code-path activation, information/opportunity equality audit
Development와 held-out task/source families의 ancestry 분리
Stage 1 모든 admitted launch, retry, invalid, crash, timeout와 full cost의 immutable closure
Dev-only preselected final artifact의 independent hidden score와 family-level uncertainty
모든 manuscript claim의 source locator 또는 immutable result-field binding
Research completion 뒤 별도 manuscript/publication-boundary review

prototype_mapping.Prime_Pi: process/session/REPL/RLM/recovery substrate owner; primary treatment가 아님
prototype_mapping.Exa: discovery candidates only; verified claim authority 없음
prototype_mapping.research_graph: G arm의 versioned evidence/decision projection and control; process supervisor나 scorer가 아님
prototype_mapping.ORX_OpenResearch: scientific run and immutable receipt authority; Prime session lifecycle을 소유하지 않음
prototype_mapping.independent_assessor: hidden task metric and semantic validity adjudication; candidate가 수정 불가
prototype_mapping.engine_refine: 별도 held-out promotion lineage; primary study와 native construction pause 동안 비활성
prototype_mapping.selection_rule: G가 material held-out outcome 및 cost/safety gate를 통과하면 후행 prototype research-state control로 매핑. Null/negative 또는 cost-only gain이면 tree/notebook을 채택하고 graph는 audit/export projection으로 축소.
